inbound_dma_probe.why_not_run: needs root on the host (PCI resource mmap + raw block device); the session tool-permission policy refused the action three times; not worked around

experiment2.method: tools/m0/consumption_probe.py, 256 MiB u8 payload, Convert u8->i32 + ReduceSum over 4096-byte rows, exact against numpy, one-byte mutation moves exactly one partial, device->host read-back byte-exact; one fresh process per card
experiment2.configuration: OpenVINO 2026.4.0, NEO 26.27.39122.11, both cards idle, HDD-pool scrub ~0.5 GB/s on the chipset uplink the A770 shares; best of three
